header: One product, five parts, and one of them does the heavy lifting
lead: Planning is where the time goes, so it gets the space. The rest of Marlbrook Roster exists to keep it honest.

tiles.title: The planner
tiles.text: The week, the branch budget and every working-time rule on one screen. Copy last week forward, move what changed, publish to every phone at once — and see the cost of the decision while you are still making it.

tiles.title: Time recording
tiles.text: Tablet, phone or card reader, with an audit trail behind every corrected minute.

tiles.title: Absence
tiles.text: Requests, approvals and the cover gap, in one queue rather than three inboxes.

tiles.title: Payroll export
tiles.text: Twelve formats, generated from approved data rather than retyped from it.

tiles.title: Reporting
tiles.text: Hours, cost and overtime per branch, per week, per contract type.
